article_title: Millennials are struggling to buy a home - but is it actually getting easier?

tasks.prompt: What is the article's central argument?
options: Millennials still face a large home-ownership gap, although some recent conditions may be becoming more favourable
Every millennial in the UK now owns a home
House prices have stopped mattering because lenders no longer require deposits
Building costs are the only reason home ownership differs between generations
tasks.correct_answer: Millennials still face a large home-ownership gap, although some recent conditions may be becoming more favourable
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציגה פער משמעותי בין דורות בבעלות על דיור, אך גם סימנים עדכניים לכך שחלק מתנאי הקנייה משתפרים.

tasks.prompt: What long-term change made it harder for younger adults to buy?
options: Average homes became smaller than deposits
Mortgage lenders stopped serving first-time buyers
Property prices outpaced incomes
Wages rose much faster than house prices for decades
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הקושי המרכזי המתואר הוא שמחירי הנכסים עלו לאורך זמן מהר יותר מההכנסות.

tasks.prompt: How large is England's estimated need for additional homes?
options: About 30,000 dwellings
About 3 million dwellings each year
Exactly 300 homes
About 300,000 dwellings
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת הערכה שלפיה באנגליה לבדה חסרות כ־300 אלף יחידות דיור נוספות.

tasks.prompt: What does “prospective buyers” mean in the article?
options: People who may buy a home in the future
People who build timber houses
Households that have already repaid a mortgage
Officials who measure inflation
tasks.correct_answer: People who may buy a home in the future
tasks.explanation_hebrew: prospective buyers הם קונים פוטנציאליים — אנשים ששוקלים או מתכננים לקנות בית.

tasks.prompt: Which recent trend could make saving for a home somewhat easier?
options: Deposits have been abolished by law
Raw materials have become free
House prices have generally risen more slowly than wages in recent years
All rents have fallen below their pre-pandemic level
tasks.correct_answer: House prices have generally risen more slowly than wages in recent years
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כאשר השכר עולה מהר יותר ממחירי הבתים, היחס בין הכנסה למחיר עשוי להשתפר ולהקל מעט על החיסכון.

tasks.prompt: In the phrase “getting on the housing ladder”, what does “ladder” represent?
options: A tool used by construction workers
A list of building materials
The stages of entering and progressing through home ownership
A government table of inflation rates
tasks.correct_answer: The stages of entering and progressing through home ownership
tasks.explanation_hebrew: housing ladder הוא דימוי לכניסה לשוק הבעלות על דיור ולהתקדמות בין נכסים לאורך זמן.

tasks.prompt: Give two financial barriers that the article identifies for first-time buyers.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני חסמים כלכליים קונקרטיים מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Property prices have outpaced incomes over the longer term
A 10% deposit can amount to tens of thousands
High rents or household costs make saving harder
Inflation and the pandemic compounded affordability pressures
Mortgage requirements can limit borrowing

tasks.prompt: Why does building more homes not automatically produce an immediate fall in purchase prices?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר לפחות שני גורמים שמגבילים את ההשפעה המיידית של הגדלת ההיצע.
expected_points: England's estimated housing shortage is very large
New dwellings take time to plan and build
Construction depends on labour and materials such as timber, steel, concrete and insulation
Material costs rose with general inflation
Demand and household formation can continue while supply catches up

tasks.prompt: Summarise the evidence that home ownership remains difficult for millennials and the signs that it may be getting easier.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך להציג גם את הקשיים המצטברים וגם את סימני השיפור, ללא מסקנה חד־צדדית.
expected_points: Millennials are less likely to own homes than comparable earlier generations
House prices outpaced incomes over many years
Large deposits remain a major obstacle
Recent house-price growth has been slower than wage growth
Some lenders accept smaller deposits or offer routes for first-time buyers
The article treats improvement as limited rather than a complete solution

tasks.prompt: Which would help prospective first-time buyers more: increasing housing supply or making mortgages easier to access? Use the article to argue for one option while acknowledging a limitation.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לבחור עמדה, להסתמך על לפחות שני פרטים מן הכתבה ולהכיר במגבלה או בטיעון הנגדי.
expected_points: Increasing supply addresses the shortage and long-term prices
Mortgage reforms or smaller deposits can help buyers sooner
A deposit still requires substantial savings
Easier credit does not create more homes and may increase demand
New construction is slow and affected by material costs
A balanced answer distinguishes short-term access from long-term affordability
